intent: Record as reviewed the rules the eval Context enforces and tests but the Registry did not hold.
observable_outcome: get-context eval lists the rules as reviewed, each proven by its test.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A suggestion's target must be a clean relative path inside the Skill package; empty, absolute, traversing or uncleaned paths are refused, not repaired.
A Skill held for a licensing question gets no reproduced diff and no version from its suggestions; the block is decided before any file is read.
A suggestion applies only while its target file in the newest version is byte-identical to the version it was written against; otherwise it is blocked as target_changed.
A target file with a NUL byte in its first 8000 bytes is not diffable, so its suggestion is blocked as diff_unavailable rather than applied unseen.
A suggestion decision must be accepted or rejected; pending or any other word is refused as not_a_choice.
Once a suggestion has gone into a Skill version its acceptance cannot be withdrawn; rejecting it is refused as acceptance_is_final.
An evaluation settles only while it awaits the judge; a second verdict on a settled evaluation is refused, so the first stands.
Only skill, runtime, tool and dataset suggestions are stored; MCP and unknown categories are dropped.
